entries.subject: DAMIT 1779: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-1779.txt. Model 1779, version 2017-05-11, pole (143°, 40°), period 2.787153 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: The retained calibration uses 27.875 ±0.362 km. effective body diameter

entries.subject: Other DAMIT shape solutions
entries.finding: The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 1780: pole (350°, 56°), 2.787152 h, version 2017-05-11. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: Independent shape, spin or scale evidence distinguishes these alternatives, or a changed release offers a demonstrably better supported model.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: The display scale "13.938 km (size-calibrated model)" (masiero-2014-neowise) implies a diameter of 27.876 km, outside the added Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 425, DAMIT model 1779 diameter 32 ± 1 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 1779 fitted to 1 occultation). Both are shown; the display scale is not changed.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
